clauses.requirement: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road and, in addition, perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle for side retro-reflectors and side-marker lamps, and parallel to that plane for all other signalling devices (including the rear lamp); a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed in each direction; any specific fitting instructions laid down by the manufacturer shall also be complied with.

In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2., and, where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.

In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall meet the requirements of paragraphs 5.5.1 to 5.5.5 (symmetrical fitting, symmetry of the lamps, same colorimetric requirements, substantially identical photometric characteristics, and logo restrictions).

In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane, the assessment being based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.

In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this requirement does not apply to the interior structure of the lamp.
In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics; this does not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.

In the absence of specific instructions, where lamps incorporate a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo may be fitted on the rear of the vehicle, and only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo on the front of the vehicle; all logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.
